local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local Trails = require(RS:WaitForChild("TrailConfig"))

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local remote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("Trails")
if not remote then
    remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    remote.Name = "Trails"
    remote.Parent = Remotes
end

local function profileOf(plr)
    local P = _G.Profile
    return P and P.get(plr)
end

local function ownedSet(prof)
    local set = {}
    if prof and type(prof.TrailsOwned) == "table" then
        for _, id in ipairs(prof.TrailsOwned) do
            if Trails.byId(id) then set[id] = true end
        end
    end
    return set
end

local function push(plr)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (prof and plr.Parent) then return end
    remote:FireClient(plr, "state", {
        owned = ownedSet(prof),
        equipped = Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped) and prof.TrailEquipped or "",
    })
end

local PARTS = { "EggTrail", "EggTrailTop", "EggTrailBottom" }

local function dressCharacter(plr)
    local ch = plr.Character
    local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    for _, name in ipairs(PARTS) do
        local old = root:FindFirstChild(name)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end

    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    local def = prof and Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped)
    if not def then return end

    local V = Trails.VISUAL
    local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
    top.Name = "EggTrailTop"
    top.Position = Vector3.new(0, V.top, V.back)
    top.Parent = root

    local bottom = Instance.new("Attachment")
    bottom.Name = "EggTrailBottom"
    bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, V.bottom, V.back)
    bottom.Parent = root

    local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    trail.Name = "EggTrail"
    trail.Attachment0 = top
    trail.Attachment1 = bottom
    trail.FaceCamera = false
    trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(def.colors[1], def.colors[2] or def.colors[1])
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.45),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.55),
    })
    trail.Lifetime = V.lifetime
    trail.MinLength = 0.05
    trail.LightEmission = V.lightEmission
    trail.LightInfluence = 0
    trail.Parent = root
end

local function apply(plr)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    local def = prof and Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped)
    plr:SetAttribute("TrailMult", def and def.mult or 1)
    plr:SetAttribute("Trail", def and def.id or "")
    dressCharacter(plr)
    push(plr)
end

local function equip(plr, id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (prof and Trails.byId(id) and ownedSet(prof)[id]) then return end
    prof.TrailEquipped = id
    apply(plr)
end

local function unequip(plr)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not prof then return end
    prof.TrailEquipped = ""
    apply(plr)
end

local function grant(plr, id)
    local def = Trails.byId(id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (def and prof) then return false end
    if type(prof.TrailsOwned) ~= "table" then prof.TrailsOwned = {} end
    if not ownedSet(prof)[id] then
        table.insert(prof.TrailsOwned, id)
    end
    local current = Trails.byId(prof.TrailEquipped)
    if not current or def.mult >= current.mult then
        prof.TrailEquipped = id
    end
    apply(plr)
    remote:FireClient(plr, "bought", def.name)
    return true
end

local function buyWithCoins(plr, id)
    local def = Trails.byId(id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    local P = _G.Profile
    if not (def and prof and P) then return end
    if ownedSet(prof)[id] then
        equip(plr, id)
        return
    end
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    if have < def.price then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Not enough money")
        return
    end
    P.set(plr, "Coins", have - def.price)
    grant(plr, id)
end

local function buyWithRobux(plr, id)
    local def = Trails.byId(id)
    local prof = profileOf(plr)
    if not (def and prof) then return end
    if ownedSet(prof)[id] then
        equip(plr, id)
        return
    end

    if (def.productId or 0) > 0 then
        pcall(function() MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(plr, def.productId) end)
    else
        remote:FireClient(plr, "noProduct", def.name)
    end
end

local lastAction = {}

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, id)
    if action == "state" then
        push(plr)
        return
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if (lastAction[plr] or 0) + 0.25 > now then return end
    lastAction[plr] = now

    if action == "unequip" then
        unequip(plr)
    elseif type(id) == "string" then
        if action == "buy" then
            buyWithCoins(plr, id)
        elseif action == "robux" then
            buyWithRobux(plr, id)
        elseif action == "equip" then
            equip(plr, id)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    for _ = 1, 200 do
        if _G.Purchases and _G.Purchases.register then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    local Purchases = _G.Purchases
    if not (Purchases and Purchases.register) then
        warn("[TRAILS] no _G.Purchases - Robux trails are not hooked up")
        return
    end
    for _, def in ipairs(Trails.LIST) do
        Purchases.register("Trail_" .. def.id, def.productId or 0, function(plr)
            return grant(plr, def.id)
        end)
    end
end)

local function watch(plr)
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        dressCharacter(plr)
    end)
    for _ = 1, 150 do
        if not plr.Parent or profileOf(plr) then break end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
    if plr.Parent and profileOf(plr) then apply(plr) end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) task.spawn(watch, plr) end)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(watch, plr) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) lastAction[plr] = nil end)

_G.Trails = {
    grant = grant,
    equip = equip,
    unequip = unequip,
    owned = function(plr) return ownedSet(profileOf(plr)) end,
}

print(("[TRAILS] %d trails, %s .. %s"):format(#Trails.LIST,
    Trails.fmtMult(Trails.LIST[1].mult), Trails.fmtMult(Trails.LIST[#Trails.LIST].mult)))

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local FLAGS = { "OnTreadmill", "AdminTreadmillRunning" }

local function running(p)
	for _, name in ipairs(FLAGS) do
		if p:GetAttribute(name) == true then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function stow(p)
	local ch = p.Character
	local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then hum:UnequipTools() end
end

local function bindCharacter(p, ch)
	ch.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
		if c:IsA("Tool") and running(p) then task.defer(stow, p) end
	end)
end

local function bind(p)
	for _, name in ipairs(FLAGS) do
		p:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			if running(p) then stow(p) end
		end)
	end
	if p.Character then bindCharacter(p, p.Character) end
	p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
		p:SetAttribute("OnTreadmill", false)
		bindCharacter(p, ch)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(p) end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local EggCfg = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local SharedConfig = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local ST = SharedConfig.Streaming or {}
local AHEAD = ST.Ahead or 3
local BEHIND = ST.Behind or 2
local EVERY = ST.Every or 0.7

local map = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local zonesFolder = map:WaitForChild("Zones")

local ALWAYS = {}
for _, n in ipairs(ST.AlwaysLoaded or { 1, 2 }) do ALWAYS[n] = true end

local decor = {}
local bounds = {}

for n = 1, EggCfg.ZONES do
	local folder
	for _, z in ipairs(zonesFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if z.Name:match("^Zone" .. n .. "_") then folder = z break end
	end
	local d = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Decor")
	if d and d:IsA("Model") then
		if ALWAYS[n] then
			d.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
		else
			d.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.PersistentPerPlayer
			decor[n] = d
		end
	end
	local top, bot = EggCfg.bounds(n)
	bounds[n] = { top = top, bot = bot }
end

local function zoneAt(z)
	for n = 1, EggCfg.ZONES do
		local b = bounds[n]
		if b and z <= b.top and z >= b.bot then return n end
	end
	if z > bounds[1].top then return 0 end
	return EggCfg.ZONES
end

local held = {}

local function apply(plr, centre)
	local mine = held[plr]
	if not mine then mine = {} held[plr] = mine end
	for n, model in pairs(decor) do
		local want = (n >= centre - BEHIND) and (n <= centre + AHEAD)
		if want ~= (mine[n] == true) then
			local ok = pcall(function()
				if want then
					model:AddPersistentPlayer(plr)
				else
					model:RemovePersistentPlayer(plr)
				end
			end)
			if ok then mine[n] = want or nil end
		end
	end
end

local function rootOf(plr)
	local ch = plr.Character
	return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) held[plr] = nil end)

local LIBRARY_DELAY = ST.LibraryDelay or 3
local library = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")

local function onJoin(plr)
	task.spawn(function()
		local placed = false
		for _ = 1, 60 do
			local root = rootOf(plr)
			if root then apply(plr, zoneAt(root.Position.Z)) placed = true break end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		if not placed then apply(plr, 0) end

		task.wait(LIBRARY_DELAY)
		if library and plr.Parent then
			pcall(function() library:AddPersistentPlayer(plr) end)
		end
	end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do onJoin(plr) end

local last = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) last[plr] = nil end)
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(EVERY)
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local root = rootOf(plr)
			if root then
				local n = zoneAt(root.Position.Z)
				if last[plr] ~= n then
					last[plr] = n
					apply(plr, n)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

for _ in pairs(decor) do count += 1 end

local Ragdoll = {}

local SWING, TWIST = 42, 26

local function attach(part, cf, name)
    local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
    a.Name = name
    a.CFrame = cf
    a.Parent = part
    return a
end

local function limpLimbs(char, on)
    for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            if on then
                p:SetAttribute("RagdollWasCollide", p.CanCollide)
                p.CanCollide = true
            else
                local was = p:GetAttribute("RagdollWasCollide")
                if was ~= nil then p.CanCollide = was end
                p:SetAttribute("RagdollWasCollide", nil)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Ragdoll.on(char)
    if not char or char:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    char:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", true)

    hum.AutoRotate = false
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    local sockets = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then sockets[d.Name] = true end
    end

    local modern = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and d.Enabled and sockets[d.Name .. "BallSocket"] then
            d.Enabled = false
            d:SetAttribute("RagdollOff", true)
            modern += 1
        end
    end

    if modern == 0 then
        for _, m in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part0 and m.Part1 and m.Name ~= "RootJoint" then
                local a0 = attach(m.Part0, m.C0, "RagdollA0")
                local a1 = attach(m.Part1, m.C1, "RagdollA1")
                local joint = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
                joint.Name = "RagdollJoint"
                joint.Attachment0 = a0
                joint.Attachment1 = a1
                joint.LimitsEnabled = true
                joint.UpperAngle = SWING
                joint.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
                joint.TwistLowerAngle = -TWIST
                joint.TwistUpperAngle = TWIST
                joint.Parent = m.Part1
                local tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
                tag.Name = "RagdollMotor"
                tag.Value = m
                tag.Parent = joint
                m.Enabled = false
            end
        end
    end

    limpLimbs(char, true)
end

function Ragdoll.off(char)
    if not char or not char:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") then return end
    char:SetAttribute("Ragdoll", false)

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and d:GetAttribute("RagdollOff") then
            d.Enabled = true
            d:SetAttribute("RagdollOff", nil)
        end
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and d.Name == "RagdollJoint" then
            local tag = d:FindFirstChild("RagdollMotor")
            if tag and tag.Value then tag.Value.Enabled = true end
            d:Destroy()
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Attachment") and (d.Name == "RagdollA0" or d.Name == "RagdollA1") then
            d:Destroy()
        end
    end

    limpLimbs(char, false)

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.Parent then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end
end

return Ragdoll

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local M = {}

function M.folder()
	return ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Zones")
end

local function mapSuffix(n)
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
	local zones = map and map:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	for _, z in ipairs(zones and zones:GetChildren() or {}) do
		local s = z.Name:match("^Zone" .. n .. "_(.+)$")
		if s then return s end
	end
	return nil
end

function M.sources(report)
	report = report or function(msg) warn("[Zones] " .. msg) end
	local folder = M.folder()
	if not folder then return {} end
	local byZone = {}
	for _, f in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if f:IsA("Folder") or f:IsA("Model") or f:IsA("Configuration") then
			local z = tonumber(f:GetAttribute("Zone"))
			if not z or z < 1 or z ~= math.floor(z) then
				report(("%s is skipped: give it the attribute Zone = its world number"):format(f.Name))
			else
				byZone[z] = byZone[z] or {}
				table.insert(byZone[z], f)
			end
		end
	end
	local ordered = {}
	local n = 1
	while byZone[n] do
		local list = byZone[n]
		local pick = list[1]
		if #list > 1 then
			local suffix = mapSuffix(n)
			for _, f in ipairs(list) do
				if suffix and (f.Name:gsub("[^%w]", "")):lower() == suffix:lower() then pick = f break end
			end
			for _, f in ipairs(list) do
				if f ~= pick then
					report(("%s is skipped: Zone %d is already %s - set its Zone to a free number"):format(f.Name, n, pick.Name))
				end
			end
		end
		table.insert(ordered, pick)
		byZone[n] = nil
		n += 1
	end
	for z, list in pairs(byZone) do
		for _, f in ipairs(list) do
			report(("%s is skipped: Zone %d leaves a gap - worlds must be numbered 1, 2, 3 ... without gaps (next free: %d)"):format(f.Name, z, n))
		end
	end
	return ordered, n
end

function M.extend(list)
	local rows = {}
	for _, src in ipairs(M.sources()) do
		local n = #list + 1
		local p1, p2 = tonumber(list[n - 1] and list[n - 1].power), tonumber(list[n - 2] and list[n - 2].power)
		local power = tonumber(src:GetAttribute("Power"))
		if not power or power <= 0 or (p1 and power <= p1) then
			power = p1 and p1 * math.clamp((p2 and p2 > 0) and p1 / p2 or 10, 4, 40) or 0.45
		end
		local color = src:GetAttribute("Color")
		if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then color = Color3.fromHSV((n * 0.137) % 1, 0.55, 0.92) end
		local emoji = src:GetAttribute("Emoji")
		local row = {
			name = src.Name, emoji = type(emoji) == "string" and emoji or "",
			color = color, power = power, source = src,
		}
		list[n] = row
		table.insert(rows, { index = n, row = row })
	end
	if RunService:IsRunning() then
		local reg = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ZoneRegistry")
		if reg then reg:Destroy() end
		reg = Instance.new("Folder")
		reg.Name = "ZoneRegistry"
		for _, e in ipairs(rows) do
			local c = Instance.new("Configuration")
			c.Name = tostring(e.index)
			c:SetAttribute("Index", e.index)
			c:SetAttribute("Name", e.row.name)
			c:SetAttribute("Emoji", e.row.emoji)
			c:SetAttribute("Color", e.row.color)
			c:SetAttribute("Power", e.row.power)
			c.Parent = reg
		end
		reg.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
end

local function near(a, b, tol) return math.abs(a - b) <= (tol or 0.6) end

local function shortPower(v)
	if v < 1 then return "" end
	local units = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
	local i = 1
	while v >= 1000 and i < #units do v = v / 1000; i += 1 end
	return string.format("%g", math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10) .. units[i]
end

local function largestPart(model)
	local best, size = nil, -1
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v = p.Size.X * p.Size.Y * p.Size.Z
			if v > size then best, size = p, v end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function bodyPart(model)
	for _, name in ipairs({ "HumanoidRootPart", "Handle", "RootPart", "Torso", "Body" }) do
		local p = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and (p.Name:lower():find("body") or p.Name:lower():find("torso")) then return p end
	end
	return largestPart(model)
end

local function anchorAll(model, collide)
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			p.Anchored = true
			if collide == false then p.CanCollide = false end
		end
	end
end

local function asModel(inst)
	if inst:IsA("Model") then return inst end
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = inst.Name
		local parent = inst.Parent
		inst.Parent = m
		m.PrimaryPart = inst
		m.Parent = parent
		return m
	end
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = inst.Name
	for _, c in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do c.Parent = m end
	inst:Destroy()
	return m
end

local built = false

function M.build(C)
	if built or not (RunService:IsServer() and RunService:IsRunning()) then return end
	built = true
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("GameWorld")
	local assets = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("EggAssets")
	if not (map and assets) then return end
	local zones, walls, spawns = map:FindFirstChild("Zones"), map:FindFirstChild("Walls"), map:FindFirstChild("EggSpawns")
	local bosses, eggSet, animalEggs = assets:FindFirstChild("Bosses"), assets:FindFirstChild("Eggs"), assets:FindFirstChild("AnimalEggs")
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	if not lib then
		lib = Instance.new("Model")
		lib.Name = "AnimalLibrary"
		lib.Parent = workspace
	end

	local function byPrefix(parent, n)
		if not parent then return nil end
		for _, z in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if z.Name:match("^Zone" .. n .. "_") then return z end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local function wallParts()
		local list = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(walls and walls:GetDescendants() or {}) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list, p) end
		end
		return list
	end

	local signTemplate
	for n = 1, C.ZONES do
		local f = byPrefix(zones, n)
		local s = f and f:FindFirstChild("Decor") and f.Decor:FindFirstChild("ZoneSign")
		if s then signTemplate = { model = s, zone = n } end
	end
	local slabTemplate = byPrefix(zones, 1)
	slabTemplate = slabTemplate and slabTemplate:FindFirstChild("Floor") and slabTemplate.Floor:FindFirstChild("FloorSlab")
	local libraryAt = lib:GetPivot().Position
	local speciesZone = {}

	local function buildWorld(n, row, src)
		local prev = n - 1
		local prevTop, prevBot = C.bounds(prev)
		local top, bot = C.bounds(n)
		local dz = top - prevTop
		local suffix = (row.name:gsub("[^%w]", ""))

		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = ("Zone%d_%s"):format(n, suffix)
		local floor = Instance.new("Model")
		floor.Name = "Floor"
		floor.Parent = folder
		local slab = slabTemplate and slabTemplate:Clone() or Instance.new("Part")
		slab.Name = "FloorSlab"
		slab.Anchored = true
		slab.Size = Vector3.new(C.X_MAX - C.X_MIN, 4, top - bot)
		slab.CFrame = CFrame.new(1500, -2, (top + bot) / 2)
		slab.Color = row.color
		slab.Parent = floor

		local decor = Instance.new("Model")
		decor.Name = "Decor"
		decor.Parent = folder
		if signTemplate then
			local sign = signTemplate.model:Clone()
			local sTop = C.bounds(signTemplate.zone)
			sign:PivotTo(sign:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 0, top - sTop))
			for _, d in ipairs(sign:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name == "Power" then d.Text = shortPower(row.power) end
			end
			sign.Parent = decor
		end
		local look = src:FindFirstChild("Map")
		if look and look:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			local m = asModel(look:Clone())
			local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
			local target = Vector3.new(1500, size.Y / 2, (top + bot) / 2)
			m:PivotTo(m:GetPivot() + (target - cf.Position))
			anchorAll(m)
			m.Name = "Map"
			m.Parent = decor
		end
		folder.Parent = zones

		local dividers = zones:FindFirstChild("Dividers")
		local lastDivider = dividers and dividers:FindFirstChild(("Divider_%d_%d"):format(prev - 1, prev))
		if lastDivider then
			local d = lastDivider:Clone()
			d.Name = ("Divider_%d_%d"):format(prev, n)
			d.CFrame = d.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, dz)
			d.Parent = dividers
		end

		for _, w in ipairs(wallParts()) do
			if w.Size.X > w.Size.Z and near(w.Position.Z, prevBot - w.Size.Z / 2) then
				w.CFrame = w.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, bot - prevBot)
			elseif near(w.Size.Z, prevTop - prevBot) and near(w.Position.Z, (prevTop + prevBot) / 2) then
				local c = w:Clone()
				c.Size = Vector3.new(w.Size.X, w.Size.Y, top - bot)
				c.CFrame = CFrame.new(w.Position.X, w.Position.Y, (top + bot) / 2) * w.CFrame.Rotation
				c.Color = w.Name == "WallCap" and row.color or row.color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45)
				c.Parent = w.Parent
			end
		end

		local prevSpawns = byPrefix(spawns, prev)
		if prevSpawns then
			local s = prevSpawns:Clone()
			s.Name = ("Zone%d_%s"):format(n, suffix)
			for _, a in ipairs(s:GetChildren()) do
				if a:IsA("BasePart") then
					a.CFrame = a.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, dz)
					a:SetAttribute("Zone", n)
					for _, c in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
				end
			end
			s.Parent = spawns
		end
	end

	local function loadAssets(n, src)
		if bosses then
			local bossSrc = src:FindFirstChild("Boss")
			local boss
			if bossSrc and (bossSrc:IsA("BasePart") or bossSrc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)) then
				boss = asModel(bossSrc)
			elseif bosses:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. (n - 1)) then
				boss = bosses["Zone" .. (n - 1)]:Clone()
			end
			if boss then
				local old = bosses:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. n)
				if old then old:Destroy() end
				boss.Name = "Zone" .. n
				local BossAnim = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BossAnim"))
				if BossAnim.animated(boss) then
					local root = BossAnim.animRoot(boss)
					for _, p in ipairs(boss:GetDescendants()) do
						if p:IsA("BasePart") then
							p.Anchored = p == root
							p.CanCollide = false
						end
					end
					if root and not boss.PrimaryPart then boss.PrimaryPart = root end
				else
					for _, j in ipairs(boss:GetDescendants()) do
						if j:IsA("JointInstance") or j:IsA("WeldConstraint") then j.Enabled = false end
					end
					anchorAll(boss)
				end
				boss.Parent = bosses
			end
		end

		if eggSet and not eggSet:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. n) then
			local e = eggSet:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. (n - 1)) or eggSet:FindFirstChild("Default")
			if e then
				e = e:Clone()
				e.Name = "Zone" .. n
				e.Parent = eggSet
			end
		end

		local set = lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. n)
		if not set then
			set = Instance.new("Folder")
			set.Name = "Zone" .. n
			set.Parent = lib
		end
		local mine = {}
		local animals = src:FindFirstChild("Animals")
		for i, a in ipairs(animals and animals:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if not (a:IsA("Model") or a:IsA("Folder") or a:IsA("BasePart")) then continue end
			if speciesZone[a.Name] then
				warn(("[Zones] %s: an animal called \"%s\" is already in zone %d - give it its own name"):format(src.Name, a.Name, speciesZone[a.Name]))
				continue
			end
			speciesZone[a.Name] = n
			mine[a.Name] = true
			local isNew = a:GetAttribute("Species") ~= a.Name or a:GetAttribute("Zone") ~= n
			local m = asModel(a)
			m:SetAttribute("Species", m.Name)
			m:SetAttribute("Zone", n)
			local root = m:GetAttribute("RootPart")
			if not (root and m:FindFirstChild(root, true)) then
				local p = m.PrimaryPart or bodyPart(m)
				if p then m:SetAttribute("RootPart", p.Name) end
			end
			if isNew then
				local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
				if size.Y > 6 or size.Y < 0.5 then m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (2 / math.max(size.Y, 0.01))) end
				m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(libraryAt + Vector3.new(n * 30, 0, i * 8)))
			end
			anchorAll(m)
			m.Parent = set
		end

		local eggs = src:FindFirstChild("Eggs")
		if animalEggs and eggs then
			for _, e in ipairs(eggs:GetChildren()) do
				if not (e:IsA("Model") or e:IsA("Folder") or e:IsA("BasePart")) or not mine[e.Name] then continue end
				local m = asModel(e)
				local old = animalEggs:FindFirstChild(m.Name)
				if old then old:Destroy() end
				m:SetAttribute("Zone", n)
				m:SetAttribute("Species", m.Name)
				local shell = m:FindFirstChild("Shell", true)
				if not (shell and shell:IsA("BasePart")) then
					shell = m.PrimaryPart or largestPart(m)
					if shell and not shell.Name:lower():match("^shell") then shell.Name = "Shell" end
				end
				if shell and not m.PrimaryPart then m.PrimaryPart = shell end
				local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
				if size.Y > 0 and math.abs(size.Y - C.EGG_BASE_H) > 0.05 then m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (C.EGG_BASE_H / size.Y)) end
				anchorAll(m, false)
				m.Parent = animalEggs
			end
		end
	end

	for n = 1, C.ZONES do
		local row = C.ZONE_LIST[n]
		local src = row and row.source
		if not src then continue end
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			if zones and not byPrefix(zones, n) and n > 1 then buildWorld(n, row, src) end
			loadAssets(n, src)
		end)
		if not ok then warn(("[Zones] could not load zone %d (%s): %s"):format(n, tostring(row.name), tostring(err))) end
	end
end

return M

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local BossAnim = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("BossAnim"))

local T = {}

local RARITY_NAMES = { "Common", "Uncommon", "Rare", "Legendary" }
local RARITY_WANT = { 4, 2, 1, 1 }
local BY_NAME = { common = 1, uncommon = 2, rare = 3, legendary = 4 }

local function say(...)
	print("[ZoneTools]", ...)
end

local function rarityOf(m)
	local v = m:GetAttribute("Rarity")
	if type(v) == "number" then return math.clamp(math.floor(v), 1, 4) end
	if type(v) == "string" then return BY_NAME[v:lower()] end
	return nil
end

local function hasPart(inst)
	return inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) ~= nil
end

function T.Check()
	local problems = {}
	local function bad(msg) table.insert(problems, msg) end
	local loader = require(ServerStorage.ZoneLoader:Clone())
	local sources, nextFree = loader.sources(bad)
	local speciesZone = {}

	for n, src in ipairs(sources) do
		local label = ("World %d (%s)"):format(n, src.Name)
		local boss = src:FindFirstChild("Boss")
		if not (boss and hasPart(boss)) then
			bad(label .. ": no Boss model yet - the previous world's boss will be used")
		else
			local anims = BossAnim.animations(boss) or {}
			local embedded = BossAnim.embedded(boss) or {}
			for name, k in pairs(embedded) do anims[name] = anims[name] or k end
			if next(anims) == nil then
				bad(label .. ": the Boss has no animations - save Idle, Run, Attack, Sleep, Wake in Animation Editor or add their ids as attributes")
			else
				for _, name in ipairs({ "Idle", "Run", "Attack", "Sleep", "Wake" }) do
					if not anims[name] then bad(label .. ": the Boss has no " .. name .. " animation") end
				end
				if not boss:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D", true) then
					bad(label .. ": the Boss has animations but no Motor6D joints - rig it first")
				else
					local root = BossAnim.animRoot(boss)
					if boss.PrimaryPart and boss.PrimaryPart ~= root then
						bad(label .. ": the Boss PrimaryPart should be its root part (" .. tostring(root and root.Name) .. ")")
					end
					local links = {}
					local function link(a, b)
						if a and b then
							links[a] = links[a] or {}
							links[b] = links[b] or {}
							table.insert(links[a], b)
							table.insert(links[b], a)
						end
					end
					for _, j in ipairs(boss:GetDescendants()) do
						if j:IsA("JointInstance") then link(j.Part0, j.Part1)
						elseif j:IsA("WeldConstraint") then link(j.Part0, j.Part1) end
					end
					local seen, queue = { [root] = true }, { root }
					while #queue > 0 do
						local p = table.remove(queue)
						for _, q in ipairs(links[p] or {}) do
							if not seen[q] then seen[q] = true table.insert(queue, q) end
						end
					end
					local loose = 0
					for _, p in ipairs(boss:GetDescendants()) do
						if p:IsA("BasePart") and not seen[p] then loose += 1 end
					end
					if loose > 0 then
						bad(("%s: %d Boss parts are not joined to the skeleton - weld them, or they fall through the map"):format(label, loose))
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local animals = src:FindFirstChild("Animals")
		local list = animals and animals:GetChildren() or {}
		local count = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
		for _, m in ipairs(list) do
			if speciesZone[m.Name] then
				bad(("%s: animal name \"%s\" is also used in world %d - every animal needs its own name"):format(label, m.Name, speciesZone[m.Name]))
			end
			speciesZone[m.Name] = n
			if not hasPart(m) then bad(label .. ": " .. m.Name .. " has no parts") end
			local t = rarityOf(m)
			if t then count[t] += 1 else bad(label .. ": " .. m.Name .. " has no Rarity attribute (Common / Uncommon / Rare / Legendary)") end
		end
		if #list == 0 then
			bad(label .. ": no animals in the Animals folder")
		elseif #list ~= 8 then
			bad(("%s: %d animals - the index and the world's bat need exactly 8"):format(label, #list))
		end
		for t = 1, 4 do
			if #list > 0 and count[t] ~= RARITY_WANT[t] then
				bad(("%s: %d %s animals (recommended %d)"):format(label, count[t], RARITY_NAMES[t], RARITY_WANT[t]))
			end
		end
		local eggs = src:FindFirstChild("Eggs")
		for _, e in ipairs(eggs and eggs:GetChildren() or {}) do
			if not (animals and animals:FindFirstChild(e.Name)) then
				bad(label .. ": egg \"" .. e.Name .. "\" has no animal with the same name")
			elseif not hasPart(e) then
				bad(label .. ": egg \"" .. e.Name .. "\" has no parts")
			end
		end
	end

	say(("%d worlds found. A new world gets Zone = %d."):format(#sources, nextFree or (#sources + 1)))
	if #problems == 0 then
		say("Everything looks good.")
	else
		for _, p in ipairs(problems) do warn("[ZoneTools] " .. p) end
		say(("%d thing(s) to fix, see the warnings above."):format(#problems))
	end
	return #problems == 0
end

return T

local function measure(pen)
    local sign = pen:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local lo = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    local hi = Vector3.new(-1e9, -1e9, -1e9)
    for _, p in ipairs(pen:GetDescendants()) do

            hi = hi:Max(p.Position + p.Size / 2)

    end
    rects[pen.Name] = {
        minX = lo.X + INSET, maxX = hi.X - INSET,
        minZ = lo.Z + INSET, maxZ = hi.Z - INSET,
    }
end

local function plate(model, root, height)

    local grow = math.clamp(box.Y / 3.5, 1, 3.5)
    bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PLATE_W, PLATE_H)
    bb.SizeOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, top + 0.3 + box.Y * 0.04, 0)
    bb.MaxDistance = 160 + 60 * (grow - 1)

    return { bb = bb, tune = tune, f = 1, grow = grow }
end

local function fitPlate(tag, dist)
    local grow = tag.grow or 1
    local f = math.clamp(PLATE_REF * grow / math.max(dist, 1), PLATE_MIN, math.max(1, grow * 0.4))
    if math.abs(f - tag.f) < 0.01 then return end
    tag.f = f
    tag.bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PLATE_W * f, PLATE_H * f)
    for _, t in ipairs(tag.tune) do
        t[1][t[2]] = math.max(1, t[3] * f)
    end
end

local function legOf(seed, n, rect, speed, from)
    local rnd = Random.new(seed * 7919 + n * 104729)
    local to = Vector3.new(
        rnd:NextNumber(rect.minX, rect.maxX), from.Y,
        rnd:NextNumber(rect.minZ, rect.maxZ))
    local dist = (to - from).Magnitude
    return to, dist / speed, rnd:NextNumber(2.5, 7.0)
end

local function roomOf(rect, pad)
    return {
        minX = math.min(rect.minX + pad, (rect.minX + rect.maxX) / 2),
        maxX = math.max(rect.maxX - pad, (rect.minX + rect.maxX) / 2),
        minZ = math.min(rect.minZ + pad, (rect.minZ + rect.maxZ) / 2),
        maxZ = math.max(rect.maxZ - pad, (rect.minZ + rect.maxZ) / 2),
    }
end

local function turnOf(was, dir)
    was = Vector3.new(was.X, 0, was.Z)
    dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
    if was.Magnitude < 0.01 or dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then return 0 end
    local ang = math.acos(math.clamp(was.Unit:Dot(dir.Unit), -1, 1))
    if ang <= TURN_OK then return 0 end
    return math.min(math.log(math.tan(math.min(ang, 3.1) / 2) / math.tan(TURN_OK / 2)) / 6, 0.9)
end

local live = {}

local function adopt(model)
    if live[model] then return end

    local penName
    for _ = 1, 40 do
        penName = model:GetAttribute("Pen")
        if penName and rects[penName] then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
        if not model.Parent then return end
    end
    local rect = penName and rects[penName]
    if not rect then
        warn(("[PETS] %s has no pen (Pen=%s)"):format(model.Name, tostring(penName)))
        return
    end

    local ok, rig = pcall(Rig.build, model)
    if not (ok and rig) then
        warn(("[PETS] rig for %s failed: %s"):format(model.Name, tostring(rig)))
        return
    end

    local start = model:GetPivot().Position

    local _, box = model:GetBoundingBox()
    local length = math.max(box.X, box.Z)
    local speed = math.clamp(1.6 + length * 0.25, 1.8, 9)
    local stride = math.max(1.2, length * 0.7)

    local pad = length / 2
    local room = roomOf(rect, pad)

    local rootName = model:GetAttribute("RootPart")
    local rootPart = rootName and model:FindFirstChild(rootName)
    local tag
    if rootPart then
        local _, tall = model:GetBoundingBox()
        local made, out = pcall(plate, model, rootPart, tall.Y)
        if made then tag = out end
    end

    live[model] = {
        rig = rig,
        tag = tag,
        rect = room,
        penName = penName,
        pad = pad,
        seed = model:GetAttribute("Seed") or 1,
        spawnAt = model:GetAttribute("SpawnAt") or workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
        groundY = model:GetAttribute("GroundY") or start.Y,
        speed = speed,
        stride = stride,
        n = 0,
        legStart = 0,
        from = start,
        to = start,
        walk = 0,
        idle = 2,
        turn = 0,
        slot = math.random(0, FAR_STEP - 1),
        phase = 0,
        facing = model:GetPivot().LookVector,
    }
    local s = live[model]
    s.to, s.walk, s.idle = legOf(s.seed, 1, room, speed, start)
    s.turn = turnOf(s.facing, s.to - start)
end

local frame = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    frame += 1
    local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local eye = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
    local ch = plr.Character
    local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local here = hrp and hrp.Position

    for model, s in pairs(live) do
        if not model.Parent then
            live[model] = nil
        elseif s.rig.parts[1] and not s.rig.parts[1].part:IsDescendantOf(model) then

            live[model] = nil
            task.spawn(adopt, model)
        else
            local t = now - s.spawnAt

            local guard = 0
            while t > s.legStart + s.walk + s.idle and guard < 4000 do
                s.legStart += s.walk + s.idle
                s.n += 1
                local was = s.to - s.from
                s.from = s.to
                local rect = rects[s.penName]
                if rect then s.rect = roomOf(rect, s.pad) end
                s.to, s.walk, s.idle = legOf(s.seed, s.n + 1, s.rect, s.speed, s.from)
                s.turn = turnOf(was, s.to - s.from)
                guard += 1
            end

            local into = t - s.legStart
            local moving = into < s.turn + s.walk and s.walk > 0.05
            local pos, dir

            if moving then
                local u = math.max(into - s.turn, 0) / s.walk

                local e = u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
                pos = s.from:Lerp(s.to, e)
                local d = s.to - s.from
                d = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
                if d.Magnitude > 0.01 then dir = d.Unit end
                s.phase += (s.speed * dt) / s.stride * math.pi * 2
            else
                pos = s.to
            end

            if dir then

                if s.facing:Dot(dir) < -0.98 then dir = (dir + s.facing:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) * 0.3).Unit end
                s.facing = s.facing:Lerp(dir, math.clamp(dt * 6, 0, 1))
                if s.facing.Magnitude > 0.01 then s.facing = s.facing.Unit end
            end

            local d = math.min(
                eye and (pos - eye).Magnitude or math.huge,
                here and (pos - here).Magnitude or math.huge)
            if d == math.huge then d = 0 end

            if s.tag and eye then fitPlate(s.tag, (pos - eye).Magnitude) end

            local step = (d < NEAR) and 1 or ((d < FAR) and 2 or FAR_STEP)
            if (frame + s.slot) % step == 0 then
                local ground = Vector3.new(pos.X, s.groundY, pos.Z)
                local cf = CFrame.lookAt(ground, ground + s.facing)
                Rig.pose(s.rig, cf, s.phase, now, moving)
            end
        end
    end
end)
